options.content: Replaces the launcher's Now tab. Sources: Loki (decision and event rows from `serve`, needs the launcher's telemetry toggle), Prometheus (OTLP metrics) and the `RimGovernor state` SQLite snapshot (`serve --observe-snapshot`, up to 5 s stale). Panel-to-source map: `tools/observability/dashboards/README.md`.

panels.description: Source: Loki, the newest `rimgovernor.tick` (the last game tick the controller observed) in the dashboard range.
panels.title: Game tick

panels.description: Source: gauge rimgovernor.game.ticks_per_second (effective clock rate read by each step).
panels.title: Ticks per second now

panels.description: Source: concern_transitions. Concerns whose latest transition carries a cause (refused or waiting).

targets.queryText: SELECT count(*) AS waiting FROM (SELECT t.concern, t.verdict, t.cause, t.subject, t.method, t.tick, datetime(t.wall_ms/1000, 'unixepoch') AS "changed (UTC)" FROM concern_transitions t JOIN (SELECT concern, max(sequence) AS s FROM concern_transitions GROUP BY concern) m ON t.sequence = m.s) WHERE cause <> ''
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT count(*) AS waiting FROM (SELECT t.concern, t.verdict, t.cause, t.subject, t.method, t.tick, datetime(t.wall_ms/1000, 'unixepoch') AS "changed (UTC)" FROM concern_transitions t JOIN (SELECT concern, max(sequence) AS s FROM concern_transitions GROUP BY concern) m ON t.sequence = m.s) WHERE cause <> ''

panels.title: Concerns waiting

panels.description: Source: concern_transitions. Concerns whose latest transition cleared (admitted, nothing to do).

targets.queryText: SELECT count(*) AS progressing FROM (SELECT t.concern, t.verdict, t.cause, t.subject, t.method, t.tick, datetime(t.wall_ms/1000, 'unixepoch') AS "changed (UTC)" FROM concern_transitions t JOIN (SELECT concern, max(sequence) AS s FROM concern_transitions GROUP BY concern) m ON t.sequence = m.s) WHERE cause = ''
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT count(*) AS progressing FROM (SELECT t.concern, t.verdict, t.cause, t.subject, t.method, t.tick, datetime(t.wall_ms/1000, 'unixepoch') AS "changed (UTC)" FROM concern_transitions t JOIN (SELECT concern, max(sequence) AS s FROM concern_transitions GROUP BY concern) m ON t.sequence = m.s) WHERE cause = ''

panels.title: Concerns progressing

panels.description: Source: Loki `colony_stage` rows: stage, since which tick, and what blocks the next stage.

targets.expr: {service_name="rimgovernor-serve", service_instance_id=~"$run"} | rimgovernor_kind="colony_stage" | line_format "tick={{.rimgovernor_tick}} stage {{.rimgovernor_attr_stage}} since tick {{.rimgovernor_attr_since}}; next stage waits on {{.rimgovernor_attr_blocker}} {{.rimgovernor_attr_reason}}"

panels.title: Colony stage

panels.description: Source: Loki `rounds_review` rows: revision, active concerns and the emergency in force (if any).

targets.expr: {service_name="rimgovernor-serve", service_instance_id=~"$run"} | rimgovernor_kind="rounds_review" | line_format "tick={{.rimgovernor_tick}} revision {{.rimgovernor_attr_revision}} concerns {{.rimgovernor_attr_concerns}} emergency {{.rimgovernor_attr_emergency}} stage {{.rimgovernor_attr_stage}}"

panels.title: Latest rounds review

panels.description: Source: concern_transitions, the newest row per concern: what it is doing (verdict, method) and what holds it up (cause). Waiting concerns first.

targets.queryText: SELECT t.concern, t.verdict, t.cause, t.subject, t.method, t.tick, datetime(t.wall_ms/1000, 'unixepoch') AS "changed (UTC)" FROM concern_transitions t JOIN (SELECT concern, max(sequence) AS s FROM concern_transitions GROUP BY concern) m ON t.sequence = m.s ORDER BY (t.cause <> '') DESC, t.wall_ms DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT t.concern, t.verdict, t.cause, t.subject, t.method, t.tick, datetime(t.wall_ms/1000, 'unixepoch') AS "changed (UTC)" FROM concern_transitions t JOIN (SELECT concern, max(sequence) AS s FROM concern_transitions GROUP BY concern) m ON t.sequence = m.s ORDER BY (t.cause <> '') DESC, t.wall_ms DESC

panels.title: Concerns: current state

panels.description: Source: Loki `clock_step` decision rows: step outcome, why a window was admitted or refused, the step cause and the window size.

targets.expr: {service_name="rimgovernor-serve", service_instance_id=~"$run"} | rimgovernor_kind="clock_step" | line_format "tick={{.rimgovernor_tick}} {{.rimgovernor_verdict}} {{.rimgovernor_reason}} cause={{.rimgovernor_target}} window_ticks={{.rimgovernor_attr_window_ticks}} stop={{.rimgovernor_attr_stop}} {{.rimgovernor_dur_ms}} ms"

panels.title: Pace: newest clock steps

panels.description: Source: Loki `clock_stop` event rows: the reason, evidence, whether the controller's own stop (`benign`) and the detect and stop legs in game ticks.
panels.title: Last window stops

panels.description: Source: Loki `clock_stop` rows counted by reason and benign flag over the dashboard range.
panels.title: Window stops by reason

panels.description: Source: Loki `authority` rows: native clock authority changed, lost or retaken, with the generation.

targets.expr: {service_name="rimgovernor-serve", service_instance_id=~"$run"} | rimgovernor_kind="authority" | line_format "tick={{.rimgovernor_tick}} {{.rimgovernor_attr_change}} {{.rimgovernor_attr_reason}} generation {{.rimgovernor_attr_generation}} paused={{.rimgovernor_attr_paused}} pace={{.rimgovernor_attr_pace}}"

panels.title: Authority changes
